l-m-e5-b02-34.s.s1.explain: 10000 won→8000 won→7200 won. Gatii hir'isa 30% 7000 won caalaa 200 won caalaa dha.
l-m-e5-b02-34.s.s2.model.0: 10% 8000 won 800 won dha, kunis 7200 won kenna, 7000 won caalaa, kanaaf B sirrii dha.
l-m-e5-b02-34.s.s2.model.1: Hir'isni lammaffaa 8000 won irratti hundaa'a, 10000 won irratti miti, kanaaf walitti 30% hin ta'an.
